g.text: GateGoldJira - Proposed database V2: main tables
DESIGN V2 - selected tables and columns, not executable DDL.
All 44 application tables are listed in proposed-v2-design.txt.
Composite project/workflow FKs are simplified here for readability.
Users, priorities, custom fields, approvals, ranks and history are in the notes.
A board shows existing issues; it does not hold a second copy.
A column can group stages, including stages from different issue-type workflows.
Each stage maps to at most one column on a given board.
